# ThemeSelection

> > ThemeSelection provides premium admin templates, SaaS boilerplates, and UI kits built with modern frameworks like Laravel, Next.js, and Bootstrap to accelerate web application development.

ThemeSelection offers production-ready starter kits and dashboard templates for developers building SaaS applications and admin panels. The platform specializes in pre-built solutions with popular tech stacks including Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and FlyonUI, complemented by comprehensive support resources and a partner affiliate program.

## Key Topics

- SaaS Boilerplates

## SaaS Starter Kits & Boilerplates

- [JetShip - Laravel Starter Kit PRO](https://demos.themeselection.com/jetship-laravel-starter-kit): JetShip Laravel SaaS boilerplate with Tailwind CSS and FlyonUI for production-ready apps
- [JetShip - Next.js Starter Kit PRO](https://demos.themeselection.com/jetship-nextjs-starter-kit): JetShip Next.js SaaS boilerplate with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and Supabase integration
- [ChatFlow AI - Laravel Boilerplate PRO](https://demos.themeselection.com/jetship-laravel-starter-kit-demo): ChatFlow AI Laravel SaaS product demo with AI chatbot and customer support automation

## Admin Dashboard Templates

- [Sneat - Bootstrap Dashboard PRO](https://demos.themeselection.com/sneat-bootstrap-html-admin-template/html/vertical-menu-template): Sneat Bootstrap admin dashboard demo with analytics and sales metrics
